name: United States
description: The world's largest economy and a top consumer and producer of petroleum, natural gas, and coal.

name: China
description: The world's largest energy consumer and top coal producer; a major importer of petroleum and LNG.

name: India
description: The third-largest oil consumer globally, heavily dependent on petroleum imports; growing coal and renewables sector.

name: Russia
description: One of the world's largest exporters of petroleum, natural gas, and coal — a critical energy supplier to Europe and Asia.

name: Saudi Arabia
description: The world's top crude oil exporter and a founding OPEC member; controls the world's second-largest proven oil reserves.

name: Germany
description: Europe's largest economy, heavily import-dependent for petroleum and natural gas; a leader in renewable energy transition.

name: Japan
description: A major importer of LNG and petroleum with virtually no domestic fossil fuel production; world's fourth-largest LNG importer.

name: Canada
description: A top crude oil and natural gas exporter, with the world's third-largest oil reserves in its oil sands.

name: UAE
description: A top-tier crude oil exporter and OPEC member; home to Abu Dhabi's vast reserves and the Murban crude benchmark.

name: Australia
description: A major exporter of coal and LNG; one of the world's top coal exporters supplying Asian markets.
